author: Slaunger
attribution: Photo: Slaunger, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vestre_Landsret_Entrance_Sign_2014-10-10.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Free-standing entrance totem of the Western High Court, Viborg. The court name is curved around the top of the red oval emblem and 'DANMARKS DOMSTOLE' around the bottom; the address line 'Asmildklostervej 21' is also a good addr query. P symbols and arrows omitted. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Dietmar Rabich
attribution: Photo: Dietmar Rabich, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kopenhagen_(DK),_Bredgade_--_2017_--_1725.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Brass number and small street name on the dark lunette above an arched gateway, Copenhagen; 'BREDGADE' is small. Distractors: 'Boffi' window sign at left, large '28' and partial 'AVLSK...' on the neighbouring building. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Bewitchedroutine
attribution: Photo: Bewitchedroutine, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Busstop_dk.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Copenhagen bus-stop sign seen from above: yellow bus pictogram, stop name in white, e-ink display with route 185 to Nørreport St. in 11 min. Timetable cards on the pole below are too small to read.

author: Anneli Salo
attribution: Photo: Anneli Salo, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vinhandel_sign_IM8216_C.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large round dark-red corner sign with a corkscrew, Copenhagen; text runs around the circle. Two smaller copies at the sides. Two small angled street plates on the corner (left one '...Andersens Boulevard 38-42', right one with house numbers 7-9) are distractors; their full text is not reliably legible.

author: elgaard@agol.dk
attribution: Photo: elgaard@agol.dk, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.ign.fr/#focus=pic&pic=92c8f8a2-d420-4a6c-8c4d-83de09a57a4b. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 40,0,1920,1080 of the 1920x1080 HD picture.
notes: Yellow-on-black Netto supermarket fascia at the right edge (logo dog cut off), with a '7-22 ALLE DAGE' window sticker and a yellow blade sign '7-22', Copenhagen; dashcam view. Left side: 'Gallery / art & crafts' at no. 58 and a 'JUVELER' sign (distractors); 'city' and 'Riporter' signs further down the street. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: LennertS
attribution: Photo: LennertS, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.openstreetmap.fr/#focus=pic&pic=88e76e6b-8fb2-473c-942b-6a3d4b0e4b62. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 1934,274,3952,1788 of the 4080x3060 HD picture.
notes: Tall vertical green banner (text rotated 90 degrees) with a left arrow pointing to the Carlsberg visitor centre, Copenhagen. 'WELCOME TO THE', '75 METER' and the bottom Carlsberg logo block are small. 'GRUNDLAGT 1847' on the building behind and the 'P BETALINGSPARKERING' sign are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
